subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the stale pin assertions are repaired and the branch is refreshed, should these official upstream action revisions be accepted in security-scanning, app-token, release, publishing, and agent workflows?
rationale: The protected security label and secret-bearing executable workflow surface require explicit owner acceptance; automated review can verify consistency and provenance but cannot authorize the security boundary change.

options.title: Approve after focused proof
options.body: Accept the grouped update after every guard matches, the refreshed exact head passes focused checks, and security owners complete source review.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker login, and Codex action updates from routine setup/build actions to reduce the owner-review surface.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Close or recreate the update if security owners identify unacceptable upstream behavior or cannot complete the dependency review.

recommendation.title: Approve after focused proof
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after every guard matches, the refreshed exact head passes focused checks, and security owners complete source review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the affected guard assertions and recently maintained the CI and dependency-guard test surface, making him the strongest individual routing candidate alongside the CODEOWNERS security group.
